definitions: A person or thing that rings something, such as a bell.
A person or horse entered in a competition under false pretences.
A person who looks very similar to another.
A player of high ability brought into a team for a specific game.
A quoit or horseshoe that falls so as to encircle the peg.
examples: He is a dead ringer for his father.
The team was accused of using a ringer.
The bell ringer pulled the rope.
She threw a perfect ringer in the game.
